findings.claim: A bare relative agents root ("agents", "./agents") is now refused where it placed the style relative to the cwd. Answered: intended; the only caller passes an absolute root (bin/lib/targets.sh), and a cwd-relative destination was the defect.
Size arithmetic obscures that output-style is the one extra member. Answered: accepted as is; the test names output-style in its message.
The outputStyle notice re-reads the settings file and swallows a read error. Answered: mirrors noticeForeignMainAgent; a read error already failed the merge before the notice runs.
nonSkillRoutes membership might validate a longterm-mem/ row. Refuted: nonSkillRoutes is read only at ondisk.go:116 to skip non-skill rows; longterm-mem rows are validated by validLongtermMemRoutes.

evidence: Parent spot check: go test ./skills ./status ./settings/... ./cmd ok; builder suite 85 ok, vet, gofmt, staticcheck clean; differential runtime identical, CLI only the new line and notice.
